title: Assetto Corsa
shortDescription: A track-focused racing simulation that emphasizes car behavior, line choice, and the satisfaction of learning a circuit over time.
highlights: Vehicle handling makes small adjustments feel consequential
Track repetition turns practice into a readable form of progress

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A useful PC racing baseline for players who want the catalog to distinguish track learning and vehicle simulation from arcade kart play.
